The '''Vidicx system''' was located in the [[Eclorar sector/Legends|Eclorar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] operation known as the [[Vidicx Campaign]].<ref name="Cracken">{{JournalCite|10|Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vidicx [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-12.<ref name="TEA" />
